body.title: Define permanent review records and lossless aggregate schemas
body.summary: Implement validated design-chunk-review v1 history/binding/digest and publication receipt types; retain complete ordered attempt provenance and immutable baselines. Separate aggregate cardinality limits from per-chunk limits in full and impact consolidation, including host diagnostics and carried finding origins.
acceptanceChecks: All accepted model and host-added feedback survives consolidation without truncation; 4097+4097 limitations and >256 combined origins pass when byte-admissible.
Reject unsupported versions, missing/foreign/tampered history; keep S1–S3 semantics and per-chunk model limits.

tests.name: U1 permanent payload integrity and digest; aggregate schemas
I8 full/impact 8194 limitations, >256 finding origins and bounded host diagnostics
